pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

2. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 100
   C. 50
   D. 10

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 30
   C. 19
   D. 60

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 22

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
